# Vector Search Q3

```{tags} reference, query-template, vector_search
```

> [Vector Search](../../vector-search.md) benchmark · [all Vector Search queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT
  v.id,
  ARRAY_COSINE_SIMILARITY(v.embedding, q.query_vector) AS similarity
FROM vectors AS v
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    query_vector
  FROM vector_queries
  WHERE
    query_id = 1
) AS q
WHERE
  v.category = 'category_01'
ORDER BY
  similarity DESC
LIMIT 10
```
